name: Wiki.js 3
longDescription: Wiki.js 3 is the next generation of the popular open-source wiki software built on Node.js. It offers a modern visual and Markdown editor, a powerful permission system, multiple authentication providers, full-text search, page versioning and a fully customizable interface. Wiki.js 3 requires PostgreSQL, which is bundled in this stack (PostgreSQL 18). An admin account is created on first start with the email and password provided during installation.
description: The next generation of the powerful open-source wiki software built on Node.js (PostgreSQL bundled)
